role: independent topology oracle, not a Flux benchmark pass

external_validation.project: byte-identical copy of original fixture project beside renamed output

local_topology.flux_conflict: ordinary window 0, channel 61, forced fragments on kicad-net-25 and kicad-net-26
local_topology.observation: Reference net 25 changes layer near the conflict region and approaches the pad from the west; net 26 escapes southeast instead of entering Flux's forced shared northern channel. This is a different routing topology, not evidence that the existing channel inequality should be relaxed.

limitations: This does not implement Flux's flowing-curved-trace objective.
The via diameter is stronger than Flux's current 0.60 mm default, not an exact parameter match.
The wall time covers the reference router process, not the separate external DRC process.
Flux benchmark dimensions, source board and source project were not changed.
The successful reference establishes existence; no reference tracks were copied into Flux.
